question: Among the posts with a score of over 5, what is the percentage of them being owned by an elder user?
evidence: score of over 5 refers to Score > 5; elder user refers to Age > 65; percentage = Divide (Count(Id where Age>65), Count(Id)) * 100
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching users record.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Age > 65, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 LEFT JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Score > 5
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Age > 65, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Score > 5

b.request: Among all posts with Score > 5, including posts whose OwnerUserId has no matching record in users (left join, so they count in the denominator), what percentage are owned by a user with Age > 65?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE p.Score > 5

d.request: Among posts with a score over 5 (Score > 5), what is the percentage owned by an elder user (Age > 65), calculated as Count(Id where Age > 65) divided by Count(Id) times 100, while also keeping posts that have no matching users record?
d.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE p.Score > 5
